words.meaning: an abundance; a full or complete supply or state
words.sentence1: The autumn orchard offered a plenitude of ripe, sweet apples. (The autumn orchard offered a plenitude of ripe, sweet apples.)
words.sentence2: She felt a deep plenitude in her heart during the harvest celebration. (She felt a deep plenitude in her heart during the harvest celebration.)

words.meaning: a great quantity or amount; plenty
words.sentence1: La tierra nos da una gran abundancia de frutos este año. (The earth gives us a great abundance of fruits this year.)
words.sentence2: Había alegría y abundancia en la mesa familiar. (There was joy and abundance at the family table.)

words.meaning: a very large quantity of something
words.sentence1: Les champs regorgent d'une belle abondance de blé mûr. (The fields overflow with a fine abundance of ripe wheat.)
words.sentence2: Cette fête apporte une joie immense et une douce abondance. (This festival brings immense joy and a sweet abundance.)

words.meaning: fullness, abundance, or wealth of something
words.sentence1: Die Fuelle der Natur zeigt sich im goldenen Herbst. (The fullness of nature shows itself in the golden autumn.)
words.sentence2: Wir feierten die Fuelle der Ernte mit großer Freude. (We celebrated the fullness of the harvest with great joy.)

words.sentence1: Yutaka na daichi ga omo mikomi wo tsukuru. (The lush earth creates a rich harvest.)
words.sentence2: Yorokobi ni michita yutaka na jikan wo sugoshita. (We spent a rich time filled with joy.)

words.sentence1: La terra offre la sua abbondanza durante la stagione della raccolta. (The earth offers its abundance during the harvest season.)
words.sentence2: C'era grande allegria e abbondanza nella festa di paese. (There was great cheer and abundance in the village festival.)

words.sentence1: Róngrùn de tiānyě zài qiūtiān lǐ sàochū xǐyuè. (The lush fields exude joy in autumn.)
words.sentence2: Tāmen huanxìng zhè fèn róngrùn de guǒshí. (They joyfully celebrate this fruitful harvest.)

words.sentence1: Gaeul deureul wie pungseonghan gippeumi neomchinda. (Overflowing joyful abundance fills the autumn fields.)
words.sentence2: Urineun pungseonghan chusuwa hamkke haengbokeul naeulda. (We shared happiness along with the rich harvest.)

words.sentence1: Chom-reang dom-nork mi-an po-kpeun knong re-tcheu ni-ka. (The harvest crops are abundant during the season.)
words.sentence2: Prach-ach-ra sa-sok sa-say ning mi-an am-no-e pok-peun. (The people are peaceful and joyful with abundant blessings.)

words.sentence1: Die landbou bring 'n pragtige oorvloed aan vrugte. (The agriculture brings a beautiful abundance of fruits.)
words.sentence2: Daar was 'n groot oorvloed van vreugde by die fees. (There was a great abundance of joy at the festival.)
